purpose: Form DIR-12 is used to file a return containing particulars of appointment of directors or key managerial personnel and changes therein with the Registrar.
when: Within thirty days of appointment or within thirty days of receipt of notice of resignation from a director.
steps: Obtain consent in writing to act as director in Form DIR-2 from the appointed person on or before appointment.
Prepare the return containing particulars of appointment or changes.
File Form DIR-12 with the Registrar along with the required fee.
Post the information on the company's website, if any, within thirty days in case of a director's resignation.
checklist: Consent in writing to act as director in Form DIR-2
Particulars of directors and key managerial personnel including DIN, names, date of birth, address, and occupation
Date of board resolution and date of appointment or reappointment
Security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, if the appointee is a national of a country sharing a land border with India
attachments: Consent in writing in Form DIR-2
Security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India (if the appointee is a national of a country which shares a land border with India)
watch: The Registrar may verify documents for correctness and adequate supporting documents in the event of vacation or removal of directors.
